entities.name: César Henri, comte de La Luzerne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: César Henri Guillaume de La Luzerne, seigneur de Beuzeville et de Rilly, baron de Chambon, was a French politician and soldier, rising to Lieutenant général des armées and naval minister. He was the son of César-Antoine de La Luzerne, comte de Beuzeville and Marie-Elisabeth de Lamoignon de Blancmesnil (1716-1758).

entities.summary: César Henri Guillaume de La Luzerne, seigneur de Beuzeville et de Rilly, baron de Chambon, was a French politician and soldier, rising to Lieutenant général des armées and naval minister. He was the son of César-Antoine de La Luzerne, comte de Beuzeville and Marie-Elisabeth de Lamoignon de Blancmesnil (1716-1758).
